# Fluxline Resonance Group

> Fluxline Resonance Group, LLC (Salt Lake City, Utah) offers consulting, coaching, brand design, web architecture, and identity systems work through The Resonance Core Framework™ — helping founders, leaders, and creatives build congruence between who they are and what they build. Founded by Terence Waters.

The Resonance Core Framework™ (RCF) is a structured identity system built on the principle that sustainable change requires alignment, not force. Developed by Terence Waters through Fluxline, it is delivered through coaching and consulting, explored on The Resonant Identity podcast, and forthcoming as a book, targeted for Q1 2027, with preorders opening in early November 2026.

Fluxline builds systems that work, brands that connect, and practices that last. It is for founders, leaders, creatives, small teams, and growing businesses who want clearer decisions and change that holds. The RCF is a decision and identity framework, not therapy. Structure the Shift. Modular by design. Resonant by nature.

## Key terms

Definitions as used on the framework page. Each links to its anchor there.

- [The Resonance Core Framework™ (RCF)](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework): A practical system for making change that holds, built on alignment rather than force.
- [Resonance](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework): Alignment between your identity, values, feelings, and actions.
- [Behavioral Gravity](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#behavioral-gravity): The pull a steady, regulated person has on the people around them, drawing others toward calm, presence, and clarity through how they show up.
- [Identity Coherence](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#identity-coherence): When your values, expression, and behavior agree. Not perfection, alignment.
- [Window of Choice](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#window-of-choice): The range of choices you can see and act on in any moment. It widens with presence and clarity and narrows under stress.
- [DRIVE](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#drive-model): Directional, Repeatable, Identity-Aligned Virtuous Expressions: repeatable actions that move you toward the person you are becoming.
- [The DRIVE Model](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#drive-system): Six stages (Spark, Coherence, Activation, Momentum, Endurance, Embodiment) that carry a DRIVE from first spark to lived identity.
- [Judgment Loop](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#identity-distortion-loop): The cycle where judgments about yourself and others reinforce a distorted view of identity.
- [Data Loop](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#identity-alignment-loop): The practice of treating Cues as information: notice them, trace where they come from, test whether they are true, then decide.
- [The Decision Integrity Index (The DII)](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#dii-protocol): Scores how well a decision aligns with your identity, using six core values and a Decision Alignment Score.
- [Decision Alignment Score (DAS)](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#decision-alignment-score): The score a single decision earns inside The DII.
- [Three dimensions of identity](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework#three-rings): Inward (the inner signal), Outward (expression), and Systemic (impact).

## Six core values (The Decision Integrity Index scoring anchors)

Embodied Awareness, Modular Precision, Resilient Alignment, Somatic Discipline, Creative Truth, and Strategic Innovation. These are the scoring anchors of The Decision Integrity Index (The DII) in The Resonance Core Framework™.

- Embodied Awareness: Integrating mind, body, and spirit for holistic transformation and authentic connection.
- Modular Precision: Systems designed with clarity and flexibility, adaptable to your unique journey and evolution.
- Resilient Alignment: Staying connected to who you are in real conditions (stress, limited energy, competing demands), not just ideal ones.
- Somatic Discipline: Recognizing the wisdom of the body and integrating physical practices with strategic thinking.
- Creative Truth: Authentic expression and honest communication guide every interaction and deliverable.
- Strategic Innovation: Thoughtful experimentation balanced with disciplined, repeatable practice for sustainable growth.
